text: Should a type with SuppressSourceGeneration = true still get MsgPack003/004/005/012/015 diagnostics but not MsgPack011/016/017?
options: Yes, validate the runtime contract but skip generation-only rules (as implemented)

text: Is the DepthStep `>=` to `>` change in MessagePackSecurity intentional as part of this fix?
